steps.title: Establish the scale and joint continuity
steps.formula: r=\sqrt\eta>0,\quad r^2=\eta,\quad c(y,x_{\rm ref})=y-\eta\nabla V(x_{\rm ref})\ \text{is continuous}.
steps.reason: Positive r,r²=eta and exact local Gradient producer make actual c continuous; scalar/vector/trig operations yield full joint continuity. Measurability is explicitly assembled later at173, as prose says. Four inputs means y,xRef,t,z, with z=(x,p), not omission of p.

steps.title: Verify identity, group composition and inverse
steps.formula: \cos(s+t)=\cos s\cos t-\sin s\sin t,\quad\sin(s+t)=\sin s\cos t+\cos s\sin t,\quad\Phi_{-t}\Phi_t=\Phi_t\Phi_{-t}=\mathrm{id}.
steps.reason: sin/cos addition, zero values and r nonzero establish same-center composition; exact both inverse orders follow from group and hzero. All real times retained.

steps.title: Differentiate the two actual coordinates
steps.formula: \dot X_t=-\sin t\,(x-c)+r\cos t\,p=rP_t,\quad\dot P_t=-\frac{\cos t}{r}(x-c)-\sin t\,p=-\frac{X_t-y}{r}-r\nabla V(x_{\rm ref}).
steps.reason: Time differentiation fixes actual y,xRef,z. Both coefficients and signs match source; second equality uses c=y−eta gradVxRef and r²=eta. congr_deriv is a rewrite of proved derivatives, not an assumed ODE.

steps.title: Keep the weighted energy nonnegative
steps.reason: Nonnegative eta inverse, squared E norms and positive divisor2 give exact H>=0 including zero energy.

steps.title: Cancel the mixed terms in the conserved energy
steps.reason: With q=x−c,C=cos t,S=sin t, the two separate E norm squares give opposite 2CS<q,p>/r terms; their sum is (C²+S²)(r^-2||q||²+||p||²). Half factor retained via common divisor. No product norm used.

steps.title: Evaluate the half-turn and collect the nine laws
steps.reason: sinπ=0 and cosπ=−1 give both coordinates (2c−x,−p). Complete tuple includes all9 laws and hcont.measurable. Source stochastic terminal law expressly excluded.
